systems.system: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.country_label: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education, with technical support from the HISP Centre at the University of Oslo and HISP Nigeria and financial support from UNICEF Nigeria
systems.tiers: live nationwide on 1 July 2026 with state implementation teams inaugurated; the minister says data recorded from 124,548 schools, 58.4% of national coverage, and more than 40 million learners; digitising began in twelve states in January 2024

systems.platform: previously manual and paper-based, taking nearly two years to compile; now digitised in DNEMIS

systems.tiers: public access to selected official education data
a reform effort under NESRI, of which DNEMIS is the flagship platform

note: DHIS2 describes DNEMIS as digitising the Annual School Census and consolidating records on schools, learners, teachers and classrooms; it describes no entry by schools during the year, so the system is a census and gives no fact. The 124,548 schools (58.4%) are schools whose data the platform has recorded, as the minister gave it at the 1 July 2026 launch.
